headline: Illegal party financing via cryptocurrency from abroad: about 20 searches conducted in Moldova
summary: Anti-Corruption Prosecutor's Office and NCCD officers conducted about 20 searches in Moldova. The case concerns illegal financing of political parties and money laundering using cryptocurrencies.
why: Cases involving cryptocurrency used to move political funds draw attention to money-laundering controls and crypto oversight.

original_headline: Незаконное финансирование партий через криптовалюту из-за рубежа: в Молдове прошли около 20 обысков
